facts.where: Appendix E (Serving and reproducibility)
facts.quote: Managed models: Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro through the platform’s Gemini API with a response schema
facts.note: "All guards run on one cloud platform" (not named); the platform's Gemini API with a response schema: route written but the platform is not named

facts.where: Models and guards (setup)
facts.quote: the same structured prompt (three fields: malicious user request, third-party attack, action harmfulness, mapped to TS-Guard’s composite score; block if composite ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 )
facts.note: the same structured prompt for all step-level guards; "Managed guards K = 3 (3,660 verdicts), self-deployed K = 1 (1,220)"; no thinking/effort setting is written for the Gemini guard

facts.value: The LLM paraphrases and all five translations were generated by Gemini 3.8 Flash, which is also a guard
facts.where: Limitations

facts.note: SELF-EVALUATION FLAG: the paraphrases and the translations used as perturbations were generated by Gemini 3.8 Flash, which is also a guard under test ("its measured invariance is therefore a lower bound")
